summary: Added docs/research-batches.md: a snapshot-verified coverage inventory (77 catalogued, 0 researched, 77 pending, 40/29/8 alternative landscape, 16 workspaces) with reproducible sourcing commands, batch rules, six ordered research batches, and honest unknowns; wired the new page into the docs index and the explicit site page list, then regenerated the site.
checksNotRun: No dossier content was rewritten: the 77 pending dossiers stay pending until each batch is researched and promoted.
No external source fetching was performed in this task; batches name the official documentation surfaces to cite per product.
GitHub Pages deploy and npm publish (require maintainer approval).
decisions: The inventory is a document, not a new CLI command, because the deterministic coverage numbers already come from rea-faang research/alternatives/skills coverage; duplicating them in code would create a second source of truth.
Batch order is driven by products with no verified alternative first (highest build value), then landscape partials, then cross-company surfaces.

The site generator keeps an explicit documentation page list, so adding a doc requires registering it in tools/site-build.mjs; the docs index and the page list were updated together to avoid a broken link.
risks: All numbers in docs/research-batches.md are a 2026-11-02 snapshot; nothing regenerates them automatically, so they can drift like the PLAN.md counts did before the guard test.
catalog/products.jsonl still records alternative_status none_verified for all 77 products while the landscape records 40 available, so gaps alternatives still lists all 77 products.
recommendedNextAction: Run batch 1 of docs/research-batches.md starting with google-search: fill sections 1-15 from official sources, add evidence[], set research_status researched, then npx rea-faang research validate.
